problemSigns.sign: Door hangs crooked in the opening
problemSigns.detail: One side of the garage door is lower than the other. This indicates a cable issue on one side, either detached or broken.

problemSigns.sign: Cable hanging loose or wrapped off the drum
problemSigns.detail: You see a loose cable dangling near the door tracks or wrapped incorrectly around the cable drum at the top.

problemSigns.sign: Grinding noise as the door moves
problemSigns.detail: A loud, rough sound during operation can signal a cable rubbing against a track or a worn cable drum.

problemSigns.sign: Door slams down faster than normal
problemSigns.detail: If the garage door drops quickly or with excessive force, it often means a cable is broken or disconnected, causing a loss of tension.
